SELECT details.spare_part_code, details.spare_part_name, details.specification, details.unit, SUM(quantity_requested) as quantity_requested FROM tpm_spare_parts_application as apply INNER JOIN tpm_spare_parts_application_details as details ON apply.apply_code = details.apply_code WHERE apply.source_code = #{query.sourceCode} and apply.source = #{query.source} and apply.approval_status = '1' and apply.type = 'out' and apply.del_flag = '0'
and details.spare_part_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.sparePartCode},'%')
and details.spare_part_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.sparePartName},'%')
GROUP BY details.spare_part_code, details.spare_part_name, details.specification,details.unit
